info.title: ClinLoop API
info.description: Event-driven clinical workflow continuity API. Synthetic data only — engineered validation, not evidence of clinical effectiveness. The API proposes; it never diagnoses, recommends treatment, or writes to a medical record.

get.description: Return ``{"status": "ok"}`` when the process is serving.
Return ``ok`` only when the database answers a trivial query.

schema.title: Response Patients Api V1 Patients Get
Response Documents Api V1 Patients  Patient Id  Documents Get
Response Tasks Api V1 Patients  Patient Id  Tasks Get

post.description:
Persist a clinical event and publish it for the workflow worker.

The event is stored before it is published so a worker crash cannot
lose it; a re-delivery of the same ``event_id`` is rejected with 409
rather than silently double-counted.

409.description: An event with this event_id was already ingested

422.description: The event payload violates the contract

get.description:
Return the patient's events from the last ``hours``, oldest first.

An unknown patient is not an error — it is an empty timeline, which
the console renders as an empty state.
List loops for a patient. Pass ``active_only=true`` to hide closed work.

get.description: Resolve explicit provenance.event_id first, validating patient, encounter and source type. Without an explicit pointer, return only an unambiguous source in the same scope.

404.description: Unknown evidence or unavailable, invalid or ambiguous source

get.description:
Return a finding.

``supporting_evidence`` and ``searched_sources`` are always included:
the console must be able to show *what was searched*, so that a gap in
coverage is never presented as proof of absence.

get.summary: Evidence node with its raw source pointer
get.description:
Return one evidence node.

``source_type`` + ``source_id`` are the pointer back to the original
record (e.g. ``LABS`` / ``LAB-8821``) that the evidence drawer opens.

409.description: Handoff is not a draft or changed concurrently; reload and retry

post.description: Refresh encounter-scoped derived links and review-labelled collections before sealing. Preserve the four SBAR text fields; accepted findings are not confirmed clinical facts.

409.description: Pending high-risk review, non-draft status, or concurrent change

ActorRef.title: ActorRef
ActorRef.description: Who or what produced a record.

ClinicalEvent.title: ClinicalEvent
ClinicalEvent.description:
An inbound clinical event on the event stream.

``source_time`` is when the source system recorded it; ``event_time``
is when it occurred in the patient's timeline. They may differ
(transcription lag) and are kept separate on purpose.

EventType.title: EventType
EventType.description: Clinical event types ingested by the workflow (≥6 required by the spec).

EvidenceSummary.title: EvidenceSummary
EvidenceSummary.description: Compact evidence projection embedded in loop/timeline responses.

FindingResponse.title: FindingResponse
FindingResponse.description:
``GET /api/v1/findings/{finding_id}`` payload.

``supporting_evidence`` and ``searched_sources`` are always present so
the console can show exactly what was searched.

FindingType.title: FindingType
FindingType.description:
Workflow gap taxonomy (≥4 classes required by the spec).

Each member names a break in the Plan -> Order -> Execution -> Result
-> Response -> Handoff chain.

LoopState.title: LoopState
LoopState.description:
Lifecycle of an Open Loop.

Happy path::

    CREATED -> PLANNED -> ORDERED/ACTION_REQUESTED -> IN_PROGRESS
    -> RESULT_AVAILABLE -> ACKNOWLEDGED -> RESOLVED

Exception / waiting states are reachable from most active states.

LoopSummary.title: LoopSummary
LoopSummary.description: Compact loop projection for list endpoints.

ReviewAction.title: ReviewAction
ReviewAction.description: Clinician decision recorded against a Finding.

TimelineEntry.title: TimelineEntry
TimelineEntry.description: One event on the patient timeline, oldest first.

TrustLevel.title: TrustLevel
TrustLevel.description:
Provenance trust of an EvidenceNode.

``PATIENT_REPORTED`` must stay at ``PENDING_VERIFICATION`` and can
never be promoted to ``SYSTEM_VERIFIED``.
